proposals.action_title: Launch First 40-Page Niche Coloring Book on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP organic traffic for specific niches (e.g., 'Cozy Hygge Coloring Book' or 'Retro 80s Vaporwave') is high. Using the Together AI FLUX-schnell free tier via GitHub Actions allows generating 40 ultra-sharp vector-like black & white coloring pages without spending a cent.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the existing 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline on GitHub Actions using the TOGETHER_API_KEY to generate 40 images for a selected micro-niche.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Text-Only & Minimalist Humorous Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-only designs (e.g., 'I Heart...' or niche profession jokes) bypass the image generation bottleneck completely. They require zero GPU resources, can be generated via Python PIL on Termux, and sell consistently on stickers and mugs.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 50 transparent PNG text designs using a Python script on Termux and batch upload them to Redbubble using a single pre-configured template.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Functional Parametric 3D Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional 3D prints (cable organizers, battery dispensers, gridfinity modifications) sell repeatedly on Cults3D. OpenSCAD script generation on GitHub Actions can output flawless STL files with zero 3D modeling experience needed.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline to compile STL files for a modular desk organizer, write a quick markdown description, and publish on Cults3D for 1.99 EUR each.

proposals.action_title: Launch 10 Niche Logbooks / Low-Content Journals on KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Logbooks for specific hobbies (e.g., 'Beekeeping Log Book', 'Mushroom Foraging Tracker') have low competition and high search intent. The interiors are standardized grids, and the covers can be generated using a basic text/image layout.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a 100-page interior PDF using a basic python-reportlab script on Termux and upload it with 5 different niche-specific cover designs.

proposals.action_title: Create and Upload 5 Multi-Design 'Sticker Packs' on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Sticker packs offer massive perceived value on Redbubble because customers get 5 to 10 mini stickers on a single sheet for the price of one. Combining multiple generated transparent PNGs into a single canvas yields high click-through rates.
proposals.first_action_today: Use a Python script to merge 6 small transparent niche icons (e.g., retro gaming items) onto a single canvas grid and upload it as a Redbubble sticker sheet.
